8bitdo-pro-3-bluetooth-gamepad: Precise D-pad, TMR sticks and remapping; the buttons are loud.
8bitdo-ultimate-2-wireless-controller: Low latency, good D-pad and gyro; some get hand cramps.
8bitdo-ultimate-3e-controller-for-xbox: Standout D-pad, preferred to the Elite 2; firmware trouble.
asus-rog-kithara: Open planar sound for shooters; wired, leaky and a weak mic.
audeze-maxwell: Outstanding wireless sound; drivers or cups failed within months.
flydigi-vader-5-pro: Adjustable sticks and extra buttons for big hands; uneven QC.
flydigi-vader-5s-wired-controller-for-xb: Adjustable stick tension; the app and wired-only use annoy.
gamesir-cyclone-2: Comfy Xbox-like shape and clicky buttons; weak D-pad and triggers.
gamesir-g7-pro: Responsive TMR sticks for less; the small shape cramps big hands.
gamesir-g7-pro-8k-pc: Mechanical buttons and TMR sticks for PC; small, with a poor D-pad.
gamesir-nova-lite-2: Hall sticks and a handy dongle that last; some Bluetooth lag.
gamesir-tegenaria-lite: Cheap, light and fast; the D-pad is a bit stiff for fighters.
hyperx-cloud-iii-s-wireless: Comfortable with long battery; too bassy or hollow for some.
logitech-g-astro-a50-x: Easy console and PC switching, good mic; flat for positioning.
razer-blackshark-v3-pro: Positional audio and Bluetooth at once; overpriced for some.
steelseries-arctis-nova-7-wireless-gen-2: Comfort and Bluetooth at once; sound and no ANC sent some back.
steelseries-arctis-nova-elite: Feature-packed all-rounder with a good mic; the price stings.
steelseries-arctis-nova-pro-omni: Hot-swap batteries and ANC; plastic build feels cheap for the price.
steelseries-arctis-nova-pro-wireless: Hot-swap batteries and dock that last years; heavy or tight for some.
turtle-beach-stealth-pro-ii: Positional audio and swappable batteries; buggy software.
razer-deathadder-v4-pro: Ergonomic shape for big hands; loud, pingy clicks sent some back.
logitech-g309-lightspeed: Medium shape with AA convenience; back-heavy and pricey to some.
razer-viper-v4-pro: Very light and balanced; the clicks are very loud.
razer-deathadder-v3: Light, good-value wired ergo mouse; a few report connection drops.
vaxee-xe-wireless: Light clicks and consistent aim; battery falls well short.
sony-inzone-h9-ii: Light, with dongle and Bluetooth at once; muddier than rivals.
zowie-fk2-dw: Liked low-hump shape gone wireless; creaky or popping clicks.
hyperx-cloud-ii: Many report a decade of use; the cable is the weak point.
lamzu-maya-x: Light, grippy and crisp; uneven quality and short battery.
logitech-g305-lightspeed: Shape, clicks and price keep fans; double-clicking with age.
razer-viper-v3-pro: Well built and accurate for claw grip; wheel and click faults.
logitech-g-pro-x3-superstrike: Better balance and fast haptic clicks; pricey, weak stock skates.
razer-deathadder-v3-hyperspeed: Comfortable at a fair price; some main clicks rattle.
logitech-g-pro-x-superlight-2c: Compact shape for claw grips; too small or slippery for some.
steelseries-aerox-3-wireless: Light with crisp clicks; connection problems for some.
valve-steam-controller: Great sticks, paddles and trackpads; the buttons feel mushy.
razer-wolverine-v3-pro: Clicky paddles and full remapping; a couple saw it fail.
finalmouse-ultralightx: Very light and responsive; flex and creaking on some.
zowie-s2-dw: Wide, gentle hump for relaxed claw grips; heavy, odd clicks.
zowie-u2-dw: Locked-in shape and great side buttons; some creaking.
zowie-ec1-dw: Light and solid for big palms; battery life disappoints.
lamzu-thorn: Light ergo mouse kept for years; battery is the top complaint.
logitech-g-pro-x-superlight-2-dex: Several call the shape their best; wobbly buttons.
gamesir-g7-se: Hall sticks and swappable parts; bumpers or triggers broke for some.
zowie-ec2-dw: Comfortable and steadies aim; the clicks are stiff and heavy.
endgame-gear-op1-8k-v2: Light and fast-clicking; too small and narrow for palm grip.
logitech-g-pro-x2-superstrike: Fast, spammable haptic clicks; front-heavy and pricey.
